fact: The Direction générale du patrimoine de l'État (DGPE) held an intensive course in computing, cybersecurity and artificial intelligence from 7 to 17 October 2025 in Libreville, delivered by DigieWomen School, which GabonReview says trained nearly 300 agents.

On 7 September 2026 the Centre Gabonais de l'Innovation ran an introductory AI-tools session for over forty agents of the Ministry of Communication and Media, ahead of the RCAPE programme planning to train 500 state agents by December 2026.
